Repaint this rough 3D blockout as a finished illustration. Keep EXACTLY the same elevated three-quarter isometric camera angle, the same composition and the same position, size and outline of every object, so the painting lines up with the blockout: the long whitewashed mazanka hut with a thick thatched hip roof in the centre (door and two small windows on its front wall facing the lower left, a small window on its right end), the smaller whitewashed komora storehouse with a thatched roof to the right, the wattle fence around the yard with clay jugs upside down on the stakes and a gap for a gate at the bottom, the dirt path from the hut door through the gate down to the pond, the well with a tall well-sweep (zhuravel) on the left, cherry trees in full white blossom where the white blobs are, three tall Lombardy poplars behind the hut, a haystack at the top right, a weeping willow and reeds at the pond in the lower left, a bench by the hut wall. Moonlit May night, the moon is to the front right: the whitewashed walls glow silver-white, warm candlelight in the two front windows, long soft shadows falling up and to the left, thin silver mist over the pond, dark blue-green grass. No people, no animals. Historical Poltava region around 1811. No text, no letters, no signature, no frame.
